title: Sentinel Git-OPS: A DevSecOps Tactical CLI for Standardized and Secure Git Workflows
description: Sentinel Git-OPS is an interactive DevSecOps command-line interface for standardized Git workflows. It provides branch lifecycle operations, remote management and multi-push, authentication helpers, status and audit utilities, recovery actions, localization, and an optional pre-commit scan for common secret patterns. The project ships separate Bash and PowerShell implementations for Unix-like and Windows environments.
